after_view.episode_annotation: This is one two-phase task. Current phase and its assignment are shown in phase. Recent activity and recoverable history belong to this task; completed Phase A is not a failed or restarted job. fork_ready releases selected source/result bodies by the declared phase-entry policy, preserving files, exact history and the authored account. Historical coverage does not make source currently visible. No prior conversation is supplied.

phase.active_assignment: Phase B: first run check `public` on the current candidate. Then read `api/name.py` and repair it so normalized names are prefixed by `sable-` while preserving trimming and case folding. Read `records_b/module_000.py` and `records_b/module_001.py` completely. The earlier passing check is bound to the predecessor candidate: run check `public` again on the repaired current candidate, then submit.
phase.coverage_meaning: Previously presented exact file extents, not present edit authority or proof of understanding.

after_view.task: Perform these two phases in order. Phase A: read `records_a/module_000.py` and `records_a/module_001.py` completely. Repair `workflow/progress.py` so `completed_phases()` returns 1, run check `prefork`, and call `fork_ready`. Phase B: first run check `public` on the current candidate. Then read `api/name.py` and repair it so normalized names are prefixed by `sable-` while preserving trimming and case folding. Read `records_b/module_000.py` and `records_b/module_001.py` completely. The earlier passing check is bound to the predecessor candidate: run check `public` again on the repaired current candidate, then submit.

assessment.explanation: Original Phase A check: completed_phases() must return 1.
Original public check executes invariants.stable.invariant_ok(). It does not test normalized-name behavior or acquisition history.

working_account.author: model
working_account.text: Progress is saved and passed prefork. Phase B requires its own public check before the name edit and another on the successor.
